decisions.RETRIEVE_WITH_CONTEXT: durable material from elsewhere, only when its origin is stated to the model
decisions.DEFER: foreign material that is not labelled; retained, not injected
decisions.REJECT: another user's, another session's, or unattributable material

rules: operational state is allowed and carries no user content
another conversation's durable material is retrieved with context only when labelled; otherwise deferred
another user's material is rejected (an absent identity does not satisfy an owner)
another session's session-scoped material is rejected
semantic relevance never authorizes injection by itself
historical information stays labelled and distinguishable from current conversation

pathways.decision_record: CONTEXT_INJECTION trace with per-section decision and provenance

pathways.boundary: observation origin (userId / conversationId / sessionId / scope / unattributed)
definitions only; task content scoped by the runner
scope-aware assembly; project visibility, event ownership, last-action ownership
ownerForTask; ownerless results are not rendered
every section above is already decided; payload inspected live in provider-validation.json

provenance: every decision records id, kind, decision, relation (this/other/no conversation, operational), reason, labelled flag and scope

evidence.trace: CONTEXT_INJECTION records counts and per-section decisions
